authorizationRationale.aiResourceView: Read semantic POST. Synthetic admission is followed by authorized domain reads and safe projection, never raw GET expansion.
authorizationRationale.aiResourceChangePlan: Preview/apply are classified update admission only. Fixed domain adapter rechecks the actual create/update/delete operation and Key references. Collection GET and confirm/cancel are human-only; every Key is denied confirmation/cancellation.
authorizationRationale.stackServiceActions: The two exact Stack batch actions preflight every persisted child with current owner and same-project/Stack checks. An authorized root grant is inherited only for dependency evaluation; explicit child DENY still wins before manager dispatch. The same recheck applies to human approval of bound-Key plans, and queued execution retains its independent live child checks. General Full and legacy admission paths are unchanged.

authorizationRationale.runtimeReadFixes: ProcessPool owner supplies stable executor bean identity, distinct from native null database IDs and nonunique display names; the opted-in metadata field is read-only and adds no methods. AI projects only its opaque digest. activeSetting is not a list-capable AI type; native schemas are unchanged. Existing domain validator-decoded decimal IDs are consumed directly as internal row IDs, while public parseScopeId retains strict wire round-trip and normal owner/Key grants/denials remain authoritative.

authorizationRationale.managedLifecycle: Closed engine-captured scheduling edges preserve exact managed retirement ancestry while live owner/Key/revision/explicit-DENY remains authoritative; ordinary ancestry is not broadened and named/file storage does not inherit destructive removal.
authorizationRationale.nativeNameSearch: Closed native name conditions narrow the already-authorized owner query before its bounded page; literal query and cursor/parent restrictions are retained. Memory projections filter before taking a page.

authorizationRationale.aiCatalogStackLaunchOptions: Read-only fixed owner projection; no create grant or secret defaults.
authorizationRationale.aiCatalogStackLaunchPlan: Dedicated durable plan. Preview/confirm/apply recheck original live destination read/create/update and references; completeInputs/confirm/cancel are verified Cookie-only, including for GENERAL FULL Keys. Apply claims once and normal Stack/Compose owners execute an exact per-event graph, with per-request actor/Key/source revalidation; private answers and proof never enter public DTO or audit payload.
authorizationRationale.serviceSetServiceLinks: Exact Service action classified update; role schema, original live Key target scope and explicit DENY still apply. No plugin or create-to-update grant.
authorizationRationale.privateOwnerChannel: Public Catalog/raw proxy initial and redirect targets reject canonical v1-catalog/ai namespace before body/upstream; fixed typed owner loopback calls retain their independent live authorization.
authorizationRationale.aiCatalogMetadataView: Fixed metadata read POST. Fresh active owner/current-project membership plus live Key PLATFORM catalogTemplate read precede a fixed loopback Catalog projection. No raw proxy/accounts grant, project ancestry inference, forwarded credentials or new JWT. Fine-grained selectors fail closed; template/version logical identities are not cache row IDs.

authorizationRationale.aiAuditQuery: Read-semantic metadata admission only. Original native role/schema/current Key and SQL/row filters authorize each source page. Fixed installed broker read-only CLI aggregates using private original credentials; Engine observes complete owner output and persists canonical ALLOW/DENY/error through existing ApiKeyAuditSink. No client-reported result is authoritative.
authorizationRationale.aiAuditSourcePages: Exactly project/account/apiKey/auditLog with bounded typed ID/time/page input; no independent input route. Original account/project selection, current membership and each native GET apply. Restricted Keys cannot mutate/export credentials; target-Key query requires original actual Key metadata read. Every Key source page pins revision; native API direct/raw routes retain their prior purpose guard and Full/legacy behavior.
